name: Tarragon
target: Soft alternate narrow leaves on upright branching stems; sparse yellow-green flower heads.

name: Marjoram
target: Small rounded gray-green felted opposite leaves; compact knot-like pale flower clusters.

name: Summer savory
target: Narrow opposite pointed leaves, fine reddish stems and small axillary pink-lilac flowers.

name: Chervil
target: Light-green finely divided triangular compound leaves and delicate white umbels.

name: Lemon verbena
target: Long lanceolate lightly toothed leaves in whorls of three, woody branching base and tiny white flower sprays.
